not_claiming: that an image-view illustrator read has the same authority as the Alpha Master Sheet

flavor text when it appears only in card art and has not been transcribed

source_policy.official_gallery_completion: If no Alpha row exists, mechanical fields are derived from the official gallery API. Illustrator is filled only when the card image credit line was manually readable.
